name: AAGVEER: Creator Partner
description:
**Welcome to AAGVeer**

AAGVeer is the official creator and community management platform for AAG. It enables creators, gaming communities, and organizers to publish games, create leagues, grow their audience, and manage community engagement through a single dashboard.

Whether you're a gaming creator, community leader, or tournament organizer, AAGVeer provides the tools you need to build and manage your gaming network efficiently.

**Key Features**

• Publish supported multiplayer games
• Create and manage leagues and tournaments
• Invite players using your referral link or referral code
• Share invitations through social platforms
• Track player registrations and community growth
• View leaderboards and performance rankings
• Monitor referrals, milestones, and achievements
• Receive notifications about new activities, events, and updates
• Secure account access with mobile OTP verification

**Community Dashboard**

Monitor your community from one place with insights including:
• Total joined players
• Active community members
• Referral performance
• Growth statistics
• Achievement progress
• Milestone tracking

**Performance & Rewards**

Grow your community to unlock higher partner levels and earn recognition based on your performance. Track your progress through an intuitive dashboard and stay updated with real-time statistics.

**Secure and Reliable**

AAGVeer uses secure authentication and is designed to provide a safe, reliable, and seamless experience for community managers and creators.

Download AAGVeer today and start building, managing, and growing your gaming community with AAG.
summary: Grow your gaming community, invite players and track your performance.
